name: sad-then-cheer
_why: The headline case: does the lamp still look sad a quarter of a minute after being told so, and does it turn around when the news does? The 14s pause is the test -- with a mood that decays to a floor the lamp should stay sorrow-dominant at a lower level throughout it, never reverting to generic ambient.

turns.say: I've had a pretty sad day today
actually, some good news just came in
